title: White House promotes Trump administration permitting reforms
text:
A White House fact sheet praises President Donald Trump's effort to change federal environmental review procedures. It describes the previous permitting system as broken, overly burdensome, and vulnerable to being used against economic growth and energy construction. The administration says new deadlines, page limits, and narrower review requirements will reduce costs and allow infrastructure projects to proceed faster.

The release repeatedly credits Trump's leadership, characterizes deregulation as common sense, and connects the policy to American energy dominance. It emphasizes delays and bureaucracy while giving little attention to environmental groups' concerns or possible costs of faster approval. The article presents the Republican administration's policy goals and claimed achievements in strongly favorable terms.
